subject: per-evaluate WCET of the PPT v1 fabric interpreter (rtl/ppt_interp.sv)

formula.exact_per_node: sum over the node's edges of (2 + max(prog_words, 1)) cycles, plus 2
formula.compiler_emitted_equivalent: 2*E + P + 2 (every compiler-emitted edge has >= 1 program word)
formula.data_independence: timing depends on table counts only, never on atom or program contents

calibration.bench: cocotb + Verilator, empty context forces the all-edges-tried worst case; start-to-done cycles counted on the RTL (bench off-repo; measurements reproduced here)

universal_envelope.correction: adversarial tables (words piled onto one edge, zero-word edges elsewhere) exceed 2E+P: each zero-word edge still costs one S_RUN cycle; found by the formal campaign, not by measurement
universal_envelope.status: base case proven + BMC evidenced; unbounded induction step open (see formal)

formal.harness: ifdef FORMAL in rtl/ppt_interp.sv (inert in sim/synth; conformance gate re-run green with it in place: 124 predicate + 6 engine vectors, 2985-sample replay, 0 mismatches) + tb/wcet/ppt_wcet.sby
formal.property: watchdog: done within N_MAX cycles of an accepted start; invariant fv_cnt + R <= N_MAX with R a combinational ranking function (worst-case cycles remaining from the current state)
assumptions_mirror_validate_image: sum of node edge counts <= MAX_EDGES
sum of edge program counts <= MAX_PROG
every node's edge range within the edge array
no table load during an evaluate (matches the load-then-start protocol)
formal.basecase: PROVEN (smtbmc yices, seconds): no reachable state violates the 408-cycle bound
formal.bmc: clean through step 275 of a worst-case evaluate (smtbmc boolector), zero counterexamples
notable_ctis: table load during the start cycle
formal.unbounded_induction: OPEN: all counterexamples eliminated (induction clears steps 2 and 1); the final step-0 query, carrying the ranking function's 48-term gated sum on both sides of one transition, exceeded the open-solver portfolio in 30-minute budgets
engines_tried: abc pdr (with and without cutpoint data abstraction)
formal.toolchain: OSS CAD Suite linux-arm64 20260819 (Yosys 0.68, SymbiYosys, boolector, yices, z3, abc, pono)

signed_stamping.signer: policy_pack.build_manifest computes it from the image bytes
signed_stamping.verifier: verify_pack recomputes from the image and rejects on mismatch; field optional for pre-existing packs
